verdict.rationale: Docusign clearly covers the signing half. It offers e-signature, reusable and shareable templates, and CLM dynamic templates that 'generate contracts in a click' with AI-drafted clauses, so a founder could sign a SAFE or note uploaded as a template. Nothing in the evidence shows pre-built SAFE or convertible-note templates on standard terms (e.g., YC SAFE), so the founder must still supply the document. Missing for 10: built-in standard SAFE/convertible-note templates, fundraising-specific term generation, and independent or hands-on corroboration for founder fundraising use.
